title: Bullish breaks
description: Two bullish breaks of structure at level 1. At 13:00 the close of 20,186 breaks above the 08:00 high of 19,956, after the dip to 19,622. At 23:00 the close of 20,230 breaks above the 13:00 high, after the pullback to 19,826. After the 20,861 high, the incomplete leg has a bearish break of its own: the 20,427 low, a bounce to 20,510, then the close of 20,403 at 06:00.
